NUMBER:
9191
 
AUTHOR:
Saint Augustine
 (354–430)
 
QUOTATION:
The spiritual virtue of a sacrament is like light,—although it passes among the impure, it is not polluted.
 
1

Works. Vol. iii. In Johannis Evangelum, c. tr. 5, Sect. 15.
